messages:
ariel: quick flag - after merging Pelion's LoRA onto our int4 build the structured JSON output is missing the invoice_number field in ~12% of cases. fp16 baseline has ~99% presence. anyone seen field-level dropouts like this post-quantize?
jun: ouch. is this on Hosted or Dedicated?
ariel: Dedicated, us-central pool, pipeline: q4_0 -> int4-ggml. I ran a tiny smokepack (80 prompts, all expect JSON with invoice_number).
lao: can you paste an example pair?
ariel: fp16: {
  "invoice_number": "INV-2026-772",
  "total": 123.00
}
int4: {
  "total": 123.00
}
rachel: missing key entirely, not mangled. that narrows it. any special token patterns in invoice_number? dashes, uppercase, no unicode.
lao: two quick guesses: tokenizer splitting vs. late pruning in the streaming writer. try token dumps for the exact token ids for that value.
ariel: running tokenizer dump now.
ariel: tokenizer dump fp16 -> ["INV", "-", "2026", "-", "772"] ; int4 -> ["INV", "-", "2026", "-", "772"]
jaun: identical tokenization. so probably not tokenizer. does the route apply any post-processing or key-whitelist?
ariel: route uses our structured extractor that picks keys by regex. same extractor binary across variants. logs show extractor invoked but invoice_number key not present in final JSON for the failed runs.
lao: check trace of token stream and finalization. maybe truncated tail token sequence dropped before extractor run. run with TRACE=gen and STREAM=on for a failing prompt.
ariel: trace captured. saw last tokens emitted but the commit event for the stream happened before the finalization hook executed on some batches. happened when concurrent_batch_size >= 10.
rachel: that smells like a batching flush race. any recent changes in the int4 runner's flush logic?
lao: we did a perf tweak for int4 to shave latency by eagerly committing small sequences when memory pressure high. there was an edge where trailing short sequences (<=3 tokens) could be lost if batch commit interleaved with kv-store flush. patch exists in runtime/main but not deployed to Dedicated images.
ariel: mitigation suggestion? set concurrent_batch_size=1 or disable eager_commit for that route?
lao: yes. quick workaround: set eager_commit=false for the customer's route and re-run smokepack.
ariel: doing that now. will run 200 prompts.
ariel: result: invoice_number presence recovered to 98.5% (fp16 was 99.1%). good sign.
jaun: create an evalpack with the failing examples and tag for CI so we don't regress. path: /evalpacks/pelion/invoice-number-int4-smoke-2026-03-23.json
ariel: evalpack created and uploaded. also pinged CS with mitigation note.
ops-bot: Patch build started: runtime/fix-int4-eager-commit-2026.03.23-7 -> dedicated-us-central (canary).
lao: once canary is up, let's run the evalpack automated check (EM on invoice_number >= 97.0%) before rolling. I'll monitor canary logs.
ariel: thanks all, will follow up with final numbers after canary. :white_check_mark:
